ITEM.PTXT: The linear control valve uses laminated valves to create a choke construction (a construction that greatly changes the direction of oil flow through the orifice), achieving linear damping force in the low speed range. The rear valve, which conventionally served as a check valve, has also been redesigned into a laminated valve with a choke construction.
Lower damping force in the medium to high speed range is achieved by reducing the valve rigidity of the leaf valve.
